_why: THE GLACIER's body (builder B, NIGHT27 boss2; GG: 'just switch back to the original [model] because it doesn't look good, and keep the effects'; DECIDE27 D-3: a large blocky skater in the web's blocky enemy style on ONE blade, replacing NIGHT26's hull + engine block). Boxes in the skater's own frame (a = right, b = up from the feet, c = forward along the course, metres; half = half sizes), each one named part: `blade` (the pale glow under the boot), `plate` (a pale chest plate), `visor` (the red-orange eye: an enemy's), `head`, `body` (dark steel). The sim's hit box is the one 2.4 x 3.4 x 1.8 m box of design.n27.boss2.body that this fits inside. Unity-only: the web had no glacier. The view draws exactly these boxes (blocky models as they are, GG owns enemy design).
